thread:
emily: Quick sync — PulseGrid agreed to a concise customer vignette + webinar mention. We need: a one-line executive quote, consent for marketing use (clips + logo), a recording slot, and webinar signup routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/pulsegrid-brief

noah: I can run the interview. CS available Thu 8:30am PT for 20m. I'll prep 3 talking points: cost, latency, integration effort.

mika-producer: Thu 8:30 works. I'll set Zoom, Otter for live transcript, and plan a 90s social cut + 20s teaser with captions. Do we want a logo lockup on the 20s?

emily: Yes include logo permission. Also ask for a hi-res logo and approval to use it. Need the hero quote to be one short sentence.

izzy: Draft quote to suggest on call: "PulseGrid reduced our inference costs ~38% and cut p95 from ~820ms to ~260ms across our September production workload." Recommend asking them to shorten to a single sentence during the call.

rajesh-sales: For routing, create leads with utm_campaign=pulsegrid-launch and hidden field product_interest=pulsegrid. SF queue = SDR_PulseGrid. If company_size > 1000 route to AE_Ops. Also add tag "pulsegrid_webinar".

emily: Noted. Rajesh please set form + SF mapping and confirm mapping here.

workflow-bot: Reminder: submit /legal-review with final quote + consent. SLA 48h.

tara-legal: Legal notes: explicit consent required listing uses (case page, social, webinar repurposing). Metrics must include timeframe and state they are from aggregated production workload. No unsubstantiated vendor comparisons. If raw logs were shared we need a DPA; confirm data type. Paste the exact final quote and consent text here for review.

noah: They'll only share aggregated metrics. I'll request a 1-line executive quote, the consent text, and logo on the call and paste replies here.

mika-producer: I'll send the calendar invite with a prep doc (3 bullets, ask to approve the 90s + 20s cuts on the call).

emily: Action items:
- Noah: collect 1-line exec quote + explicit consent + logo (due EOD Thu)
- Mika: calendar + recording + captions + promo edit plan (invite sent)
- Rajesh: implement form fields + SF routing (SDR_PulseGrid + product_interest + utm_campaign)
- Tara: legal to review final quote (48h SLA)

izzy: For the launch post, I'll draft two headlines (technical & customer-facing) and a 3-bullet benchmark snippet. Will post drafts after the quote is finalized.

emily: Good. Target timeline: publish case vignette next Wednesday, social promo same day, webinar ~7 business days after publish. If legal returns redlines we'll shift by a week.

workflow-bot: Task created: "PulseGrid case + legal review" assigned to tara-legal, due in 48h after submission.
